changelog: **Eighteen languages again.** Besides English and Korean, the interface is available again in Arabic, Chinese (Simplified and Traditional), Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Russian, Spanish (Latin America and Spain), Thai, Turkish and Vietnamese; if you had chosen one of them before, Loop Studio starts in it again. In these languages the text added with the redesign is a translation draft that native speakers have not yet reviewed. Arabic text reads right to left, while the menus, panels and run bar keep the same places as in every other language.
